name: appxray
description: Evidence-first reverse engineering & app intelligence plugin for Android, iOS, and Web. Inspect workflows, extract business logic, compare apps, and generate practical product blueprints.
suggestedPrompts: /appxray-discover to list third-party apps and APK paths on my connected Android device
/appxray to run an evidence-based product and business logic analysis on an app
/appxray-compare to compare multiple apps and generate an MVP product blueprint
